connectorUiConfig.title: Microsoft Intune - Graph API (CCF)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Codeless connector that polls Microsoft Graph for **Intune device management audit events** and **managed devices** beyond what Intune Diagnostic Settings provide. Pairs with the `Microsoft Intune (Diagnostic Settings)` connector. Requires an Entra ID app registration with `DeviceManagementApps.Read.All`, `DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All`, `DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All`, and `DeviceManagementRBAC.Read.All` application permissions (admin-consented).

sampleQueries.description: Intune audit events (Graph) in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query: IntuneGraph_AuditEvents_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | project TimeGenerated, activityType_s, activityOperationType_s, userPrincipalName_s, resources_s

IntuneGraph_ManagedDevices_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | extend lastSync = todatetime(lastSyncDateTime_s) | where lastSync < ago(30d) | project deviceName_s, userPrincipalName_s, operatingSystem_s, complianceState_s, lastSync

dataTypes.name: IntuneGraph_AuditEvents_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: IntuneGraph_AuditEvents_CL | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated) | where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: IntuneGraph_ManagedDevices_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery: IntuneGraph_ManagedDevices_CL | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated) | where isnotempty(Time)

customs.name: Microsoft Entra app (application permissions, admin-consented)
customs.description: Register an app in Entra ID and grant: `DeviceManagementApps.Read.All`, `DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All`, `DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All`, `DeviceManagementRBAC.Read.All` on Microsoft Graph. Generate a client secret.

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Register an Entra ID application
instructionSteps.description: In the Entra admin center, create an app registration. Note the **Application (client) ID** and **Directory (tenant) ID**. Generate a **client secret** and copy the value (you will not see it again).

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 - Grant Graph API permissions
instructionSteps.description:
On the app's **API permissions** blade, add the following **Application** permissions from Microsoft Graph, then click **Grant admin consent**:
- `DeviceManagementApps.Read.All`
- `DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All`
- `DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All`
- `DeviceManagementRBAC.Read.All`

Reference: [Intune Graph overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/intune-graph-overview).

instructionSteps.title: Step 3 - Connect
instructionSteps.description: Enter the tenant ID, client ID, and client secret below and click Connect.
